svg.title: Contribution graph for SchneizelCodes
svg.desc: An animated snake eats the squares of the contribution graph. 893 contributions in the last year across 61 active days. Longest streak 24 days. Best day Oct 16 with 94 contributions.

g.text: Every square is a day of work. The snake eats them all.
